statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The Globex reopening is the current price-discovery checkpoint; live NQ path evidence is not yet sufficiently verified, while Gulf energy disruption keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold pending verified evidence on gap persistence, retracement depth and repeated extension.
headline: Globex reopening enters WATCH as Gulf energy shock keeps Stress extreme
body: The reopening hour carries concentrated gap and whipsaw risk from Saudi pipeline and Hormuz disruptions, elevated oil sensitivity and high Treasury yields. Available public feeds do not yet provide sufficiently current NQ path detail to confirm persistent one-way structure, so Tail remains below 25%.
